rules.statement: Part payment can stop the running of prescription under section 13 of Ordinance No. 22 of 1871 if it is from which an acknowledgment of the debt can be implied.
rules.supporting_quote: "It has been held by this Court in the following cases, Sawanna Pana Lana Sathappa Chetty v. Kawana Payana Muttu Ramen Chetty,[1 5 S. C. C. 62.] Bacho Appu v. Ramblan [2 (1912) 14 N. L. R. 1] and Arunasalam v. Ramasamy [3 (1915) 17 N. L. R. 156.] that part payment has the effect under section 13 of Ordinance No. 22 of 1871 of breaking the prescriptive period, i.e., a part payment from which an acknowledgment of the debt can be implied."
